notes.title: DRAGOT v1.1.2
notes.notes:
-Added sound effects to main menu buttons
-Disabled runs tab of encyclopedia for now
-Tweaked ice cube mechanics to fix glitches with certain item combos
-Area 3 boss now slams into force field as if it was a wall
-Removed incorrect death sound effect from slime and ghost enemies
-Fixed glitch with buttons being highlighted even if your cursor was hidden

notes.title: DRAGOT v1.1.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed Haunted Mannequin encyclopedia entry
-Made Haunted Mannequin work with demon class
-Fixed Chain Sword not working with demon lifesteal
-BURNING!! status effect message no longer shows if you are immune
-You now no longer have to select a control method to move when playing with no save data
-In the settings menu the checkboxes for the drag control method now work correctly
-The main menu is no longer dim if you play with lighting turned off

notes.title: DRAGOT v1.1
notes.notes:
DRAGOT's biggest update yet. This update adds new content as well as QOL additions and some minor bugfixes and balancing tweaks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44128345/3fb33f81863b861cb73d53d3c258bd76260b5866.png[/img]

Patch Notes:

-Added 4 new items
-Added a new control option for dragging the player in the settings menu
-You can now use the 1, 2 and 3 buttons to quickly choose level up options
-Added the ability to skip boss chests after opening them
-The cursor now only breaks from the player if there is an obstacle in the way and never because of moving too fast
-Added two tutorial tips after the tutorial room for first time players
-Fixed knight ability not damaging bosses
-You can now click the weapon name to pick it up in the weapon pick-up menu
-Made Peaceful and Legendary runs more feasible
-Updated Ornate Scabbard item description text
-Buffed Crooked Copper Rod
-Furious Scepter now works in boss rooms
